name: set preserves arbitrary payload bytes and exact sizes
input: a value containing a newline and a null byte
test:
payload = b'a
\x00b'
request = b'set blob 4
' + payload + b'
get blob
'
assert process_protocol(request) == b'STORED
VALUE blob 4
' + payload + b'
END
'

name: multi-get follows request order and returns one ending marker
input: two keys, an absent key, and one repeated key
test:
request = (b'set first 1
A
'
           b'set second 2
BC
'
           b'get second missing first second
')
expected = (b'STORED
STORED
'
            b'VALUE second 2
BC
'
            b'VALUE first 1
A
'
            b'VALUE second 2
BC
END
')
assert process_protocol(request) == expected

name: later sets overwrite and absent gets are valid
input: the same key is assigned twice before an absent lookup
test:
request = b'set k 3
old
set k 1
N
get k
get ghost
'
assert process_protocol(request) == b'STORED
STORED
VALUE k 1
N
END
END
'

input: an invalid key and a payload without its trailing newline
